entities.summary: Tyrone M. Carter is an American former professional football safety who played in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Minnesota Golden Gophers, earned All-American honors and won several national awards. He played for the Minnesota Vikings, New York Jets, Pittsburgh Steelers, and San Diego Chargers. Carter was also a member of the Washington Redskins but did not play in any games for them.
